hooks.name: Run tests on Python save
hooks.description: Runs a fast smoke set (parsers, event fields, innerHTML guard hook, dependency direction, Kiro assets; about 40 seconds) whenever the agent saves or edits a Python file. It does not run the full suite.

action.command: python -m pytest -q -x -p no:cacheprovider tests/unit/test_parsers.py tests/unit/test_core_event_fields.py tests/unit/test_guard_hook.py tests/unit/test_dependency_direction.py tests/unit/test_kiro_assets.py
